title: Integer overflow — int, long long and where sums blow up
summary: Ranges of int and long long, the operations that overflow in DSA problems, and safe patterns like mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2.
note:
1. Ranges
   • `int` ≈ ±**2.147·10⁹** · `long long` ≈ ±9.22·10¹⁸
   • Two values up to 10⁹ fit (2·10⁹) — just; three don't
2. Where it happens
   • Prefix sums / totals of many values
   • `mid = (lo + hi) / 2` → use `lo + (hi - lo) / 2`
   • `a * b` of two ints overflows **before** being stored → `(long long)a * b`
   • `accumulate(..., 0)` sums in int → use `0LL`
3. Spotting it
   • Wrong only on large tests, or negative results that should be positive
   • Default to `long long` for sums, products and pair counts
✎ In my words: ______________________________________________

recall.q: Why does `long long x = a * b;` still overflow for ints a, b?
recall.a: The multiplication happens in int before conversion; cast first.

recall.q: How do you make accumulate sum in long long?

shot.title: Overflow checklist
shot.body:
| Pattern | Fix |
|---|---|
| sum of many values | `long long` accumulator |
| `(lo + hi) / 2` | `lo + (hi - lo) / 2` |
| `a * b` with ints | `(long long)a * b` |
| `accumulate(b, e, 0)` | `accumulate(b, e, 0LL)` |
| counting pairs (n²) | `long long` count |

sections.title: Ranges
sections.body:
✍️ `int` is 32-bit: about ±2.147·10⁹ (2³¹ − 1 = 2,147,483,647).
✍️ `long long` is 64-bit: about ±9.22·10¹⁸.
✍️ Two values up to 10⁹ added together can exceed `int`. A product of two values up to 10⁵ (10¹⁰) exceeds `int`.

sections.title: Where it happens in DSA
sections.body:
✍️ Prefix sums of 10⁵ values up to 10⁴ → up to 10⁹, borderline; values up to 10⁹ → definitely `long long`.
✍️ `mid = (lo + hi) / 2` overflows when lo + hi > 2·10⁹. Use `mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2`.
✍️ Multiplying `a * b` where both are `int` overflows **before** being stored in a `long long`. Write `(long long)a * b`.
✍️ Binary search on answer with a large `hi` (e.g. sum of weights) → make lo, hi, mid `long long`.

sections.title: How to spot it
sections.body:
✍️ Wrong answer only on large tests, negative results that should be positive → overflow.
- Default to `long long` for any sum, product, or count of pairs. It costs nothing in speed.
